1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game based on IDEA.md
2: // Assumes there is a <canvas id="game"></canvas> in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7: 
8:   // Set canvas size (fallback to 800x600 if not styled)
9:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
11: 
12:   // Ship definition
13:   const ship = {
14:     x: canvas.width / 2,
15:     y: canvas.height - 50,
16:     radius: 15,
17:     speed: 5,
18:     color: '#00ff00',
19:     dx: 0,
20:     dy: 0,
21:     update() {
22:       this.x += this.dx;
23:       this.y += this.dy;
24:       // Keep within bounds
25:       this.x = Math.max(this.radius, Math.min(canvas.width - this.radius, this.x));
26:       this.y = Math.max(this.radius, Math.min(canvas.height - this.radius, this.y));
27:     },
28:     draw() {
29:       ctx.fillStyle = this.color;
30:       ctx.beginPath();
31:       ctx.moveTo(this.x, this.y - this.radius);
32:       ctx.lineTo(this.x - this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
33:       ctx.lineTo(this.x + this.radius, this.y + this.radius);
34:       ctx.closePath();
35:       ctx.fill();
36:     },
37:   };
38: 
39:   // Asteroid definition
40:   const asteroids = [];
41:   let asteroidSpawnInterval = 2000; // ms
42:   let lastSpawn = 0;
43:   let asteroidSpeed = 2;
44: 
45:   function spawnAsteroid() {
46:     const radius = 20 + Math.random() * 20;
47:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - 2 * radius) + radius;
48:     const y = -radius;
49:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, speed: asteroidSpeed, color: '#888' });
50:   }
51: 
52:   function updateAsteroids(delta) {
53:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
54:       const a = asteroids[i];
55:       a.y += a.speed;
56:       // remove off‑screen
57:       if (a.y - a.radius > canvas.height) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
58:     }
59:     // increase difficulty over time
60:     asteroidSpeed = Math.min(12, asteroidSpeed + delta * 0.00001);
61:   }
62: 
63:   function drawAsteroids() {
64:     ctx.fillStyle = '#888';
65:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
66:       ctx.beginPath();
67:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
68:       ctx.fill();
69:     });
70:   }
71: 
72:   function checkCollision() {
73:     for (const a of asteroids) {
74:       const dx = a.x - ship.x;
75:       const dy = a.y - ship.y;
76:       const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
77:       if (dist < a.radius + ship.radius) {
78:         return true;
79:       }
80:     }
81:     return false;
82:   }
83: 
84:   let lastTime = performance.now();
85:   let gameOver = false;
86: 
87:   function loop(timestamp) {
88:     const delta = timestamp - lastTime;
89:     lastTime = timestamp;
90: 
91:     if (gameOver) {
92:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
93:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
94:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
95:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
96:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
97:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
98:       return;
99:     }
100: 
101:     // spawn logic
102:     if (timestamp - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
103:       spawnAsteroid();
104:       lastSpawn = timestamp;
105:       // gradually speed up spawning
106:       asteroidSpawnInterval = Math.max(500, asteroidSpawnInterval - 20);
107:     }
108: 
109:     // Update entities
110:     ship.update();
111:     updateAsteroids(delta);
112: 
113:     // Check collisions
114:     if (checkCollision()) {
115:       gameOver = true;
116:     }
117: 
118:     // Render
119:     ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
120:     ship.draw();
121:     drawAsteroids();
122: 
123:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
124:   }
125: 
126:   // Input handling (arrow keys)
127:   const keys = {};
128:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
129:     keys[e.key] = true;
130:     updateDirection();
131:   });
132:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
133:     keys[e.key] = false;
134:     updateDirection();
135:   });
136: 
137:   function updateDirection() {
138:     ship.dx = 0;
139:     ship.dy = 0;
140:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
141:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
142:     if (keys['ArrowUp']) ship.dy = -ship.speed;
143:     if (keys['ArrowDown']) ship.dy = ship.speed;
144:   }
145: 
146:   // Start the loop
147:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
148: })();
